```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Script: 03_construct_index.R
# Purpose: Urban Opportunity Index (UOI) using PCA
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
# pacman::p_load(tidyverse, sf, here, psych, knitr, cli)

options(scipen = 999)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "-")

# Paths
input_csv   <- "~/Downloads/URBAN-INEQUALITY-IN-BARODA/data/processed/ward_accessibility.csv"
input_gpkg  <- "~/Downloads/URBAN-INEQUALITY-IN-BARODA/data/processed/vadodara_results.gpkg"
output_csv  <- "~/Downloads/URBAN-INEQUALITY-IN-BARODA/data/processed/ward_uoi_scores.csv"
output_gpkg <- "~/Downloads/URBAN-INEQUALITY-IN-BARODA/data/processed/vadodara_final_index.gpkg"

cli::cli_h1("STEP 3: Urban Opportunity Index Construction (PCA)")

if (!file.exists(input_csv)) cli::cli_abort("Input CSV not found")

cli::cli_h2("Loading Accessibility Data")

df_access <- read_csv(input_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

metrics <- df_access %>%
  dplyr::select(time_hospital, time_school, time_transport)

# Compact diagnostics
diagnostics <- metrics %>%
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   list(
                     Min = min,
                     Median = median,
                     Mean = mean,
                     Max = max
                   ),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))

cli::cli_alert_success("Accessibility data loaded successfully")
print(kable(t(diagnostics), col.names = "Minutes", format = "simple"))

cli::cli_h2("Principal Component Analysis")

metrics_inverted <- metrics * -1

pca_result <- prcomp(metrics_inverted, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

variance_table <- tibble(
  Component = paste0("PC", 1:length(pca_result$sdev)),
  Variance_Explained = round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2, ] * 100, 1)
)

print(kable(variance_table, caption = "Variance Explained by Components"))

pc1_var <- variance_table$Variance_Explained[1]

if (pc1_var >= 60) {
  cli::cli_alert_success("PC1 explains {pc1_var}% of variance (Strong index)")
} else {
  cli::cli_alert_warning("PC1 explains only {pc1_var}% of variance (Interpret cautiously)")
}

normalize_01 <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}

raw_scores <- pca_result$x[, 1]
uoi_scores <- normalize_01(raw_scores) * 100

final_df <- df_access %>%
  mutate(
    PCA_Score = round(raw_scores, 3),
    UOI_Score = round(uoi_scores, 1),
    Rank = dense_rank(desc(UOI_Score))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Rank) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Rank, ward_id, UOI_Score, PCA_Score,
    time_hospital, time_school, time_transport
  )

write_csv(final_df, output_csv)
cli::cli_alert_success("UOI scores saved → {output_csv}")

cli::cli_h2("Saving Spatial Output")

if (file.exists(input_gpkg)) {

  wards_geo <- st_read(input_gpkg,
                       layer = "wards_with_access",
                       quiet = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(ward_id, geom)

  wards_final <- left_join(wards_geo, final_df, by = "ward_id")

  st_write(
    wards_final,
    output_gpkg,
    layer = "uoi_scores",
    delete_dsn = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  cli::cli_alert_success("Spatial layer saved → {output_gpkg}")

} else {
  cli::cli_alert_warning("GPKG not found — map export skipped")
}

cli::cli_h1("FINAL RESULTS SUMMARY")

cli::cli_h2("Top 5 Wards (Highest Opportunity)")
print(kable(
  final_df %>% slice_head(n = 5),
  format = "simple"
))

cli::cli_h2("Bottom 5 Wards (Lowest Opportunity)")
print(kable(
  final_df %>% slice_tail(n = 5),
  format = "simple"
))

city_stats <- final_df %>%
  summarise(
    Average_UOI = round(mean(UOI_Score), 1),
    Median_UOI  = round(median(UOI_Score), 1),
    Std_Dev     = round(sd(UOI_Score), 1)
  )

cli::cli_h2("City-wide Statistics")
print(kable(city_stats, format = "simple"))

cli::cli_alert_success("UOI construction completed successfully")

```
